verses.1:
The sons of Issachar:
 Tola, Puah, + 7:1 Puah is a variant of Puvah ; see Genesis 46:13|GEN 46:13 and Numbers 26:23. Jashub, and Shimron— four in all.
verses.2:
The sons of Tola:
 Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Ibsam, and Shemuel, the heads of their families. In the days of David, 22,600 descendants of Tola were numbered in their genealogies as mighty men of valor.
verses.3:
The son + 7:3 Hebrew sons ; also in verses 10 and 17 of Uzzi:
 Izrahiah.
 The sons of Izrahiah:
 Michael, Obadiah, Joel, and Isshiah. All five of them were chiefs.
verses.4: In addition to them, according to their genealogy, they had 36,000 troops for battle, for they had many wives and children.
verses.5:
Their kinsmen belonging to all the families of Issachar who were mighty men of valor totaled 87,000, as listed in their genealogies.
 The Descendants of Benjamin
verses.6:
The three sons of Benjamin:
 Bela, Becher, and Jediael.
verses.7:
The sons of Bela:
 Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth, and Iri, heads of their families— five in all. There were 22,034 mighty men of valor listed in their genealogies.
verses.8:
The sons of Becher:
 Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth, and Alemeth; all these were Becher’s sons.
verses.9: Their genealogies were recorded according to the heads of their families— 20,200 mighty men of valor.
verses.10:
The son of Jediael:
 Bilhan.
 The sons of Bilhan:
 Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, and Ahishahar.
verses.11: All these sons of Jediael were heads of their families, mighty men of valor; there were 17,200 fit for battle.
verses.12:
The Shuppites and Huppites were descendants of Ir, and the Hushites were descendants of Aher.
 The Descendants of Naphtali
verses.13:
The sons of Naphtali:
 Jahziel, + 7:13 Jahziel is a variant of Jahzeel ; see Genesis 46:24|GEN 46:24 . Guni, Jezer, and Shallum + 7:13 Most Hebrew manuscripts; some Hebrew and LXX manuscripts Shillem ; see Genesis 46:24|GEN 46:24 and Numbers 26:49. — the descendants of Bilhah.
 The Descendants of Manasseh
verses.14:
The descendants of Manasseh: Asriel
 through his Aramean concubine. She also gave birth to Machir the father of Gilead.
verses.15:
Machir took a wife from among the Huppites and Shuppites. The name of his sister was Maacah.
 Another descendant was named Zelophehad, who had only daughters.
verses.16: Machir’s wife Maacah gave birth to a son, and she named him Peresh. His brother was named Sheresh, and his sons were Ulam and Rekem.
verses.17:
The son of Ulam:
 Bedan.
 These were the sons of Gilead son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.
verses.18: His sister Hammolecheth gave birth to Ishhod, Abiezer, and Mahlah.
verses.19:
And these were the sons of Shemida:
 Ahian, Shechem, Likhi, and Aniam.
 The Descendants of Ephraim
verses.20:
The descendants of Ephraim:
 Shuthelah, Bered his son, Tahath his son, Eleadah his son, Tahath his son,
verses.21:
Zabad his son, and Shuthelah his son.
 Ezer and Elead were killed by the natives of Gath, because they went down to steal their livestock.
verses.22: Their father Ephraim mourned for many days, and his relatives came to comfort him.
verses.23: And again he slept with his wife, and she conceived and gave birth to a son. So he named him Beriah, + 7:23 Beriah sounds like the Hebrew for tragedy or disaster . because tragedy had come upon his house.
verses.24: His daughter was Sheerah, who built Lower and Upper Beth-horon, as well as Uzzen-sheerah.
verses.25: Additionally, Rephah was his son, Resheph his son, + 7:25 Some LXX manuscripts; Hebrew does not include his son . Telah his son, Tahan his son,
verses.26: Ladan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,
verses.27: Nun + 7:27 Or Non his son, and Joshua his son.
verses.28: Their holdings and settlements included Bethel and its villages, Naaran to the east, Gezer and its villages to the west, and Shechem and its villages as far as Ayyah + 7:28 Ayyah is another name for Gaza ; see also LXX. and its villages.
verses.29:
And along the borders of Manasseh were Beth-shean, + 7:29 Beth-shean is a variant of Beth-shan ; see 1 Samuel 31:10|1SA 31:10 and 2 Samuel 21:12. Taanach, Megiddo, and Dor, together with their villages. The descendants of Joseph son of Israel lived in these towns.
 The Descendants of Asher
verses.30:
The children of Asher:
 Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, Beriah, and their sister Serah.
verses.31:
The sons of Beriah:
 Heber, as well as Malchiel, who was the father of Birzaith.
verses.32: Heber was the father of Japhlet, Shomer, and Hotham, and of their sister Shua.
verses.33:
The sons of Japhlet:
 Pasach, Bimhal, and Ashvath. These were Japhlet’s sons.
verses.34:
The sons of Shemer:
 Ahi, Rohgah, + 7:34 Or The sons of his brother Shemer: Rohgah ; note that Shemer is a variant of Shomer ; see verse 32. Hubbah, and Aram.
verses.35:
The sons of his brother Helem: + 7:35 Helem is possibly another name for Hotham ; see verse 32. 
 Zophah, Imna, Shelesh, and Amal.
verses.36:
The sons of Zophah:
 Suah, Harnepher, Shual, Beri, Imrah,
verses.37: Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilshah, Ithran, + 7:37 Ithran is possibly a variant of Jether ; see verse 38. and Beera.
verses.38:
The sons of Jether:
 Jephunneh, Pispa, and Ara.
verses.39:
The sons of Ulla:
 Arah, Hanniel, and Rizia.
verses.40: All these were the descendants of Asher — heads of their families, choice and mighty men of valor, and chiefs among the leaders. The number of men fit for battle, recorded in their genealogies, was 26,000.
